ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b
@graph.ai_informationAboutApplication:
Intended uses: Reasoning, code generation, tool calling, agentic workflows, and multilingual dialog; also usable as the backbone model for agentic coding tools. Designed for enterprise and research use (Granite family).
Target systems: Agentic workflows and agentic coding harnesses (backbone model for agentic coding tools), tool-calling systems, and multilingual dialog/chat
@graph.ai_limitation: Multilingual performance may vary compared to English (few-shot examples can help); the model may occasionally produce inaccurate, biased, or unsafe responses; content within <think>...</think> tags is internal reasoning that may be unpolished or intermediate and not final conclusions.

ai_metric.value: Granite-4.2-8B (8B Dense) scores: AIME25 86.67, HMMT Feb25 78.33, GPQA 64.14, LiveCodeBench v6 73.24, SciCode 36.09, MMLU-Pro 74.04, IFBench (prompt) 79.33, SWE Bench Verified 47.67, BFCL (v4) 52.39, RULER 128K 71.41. The card's table gives no explicit metric names.

externalRef.comment: Distribution channels: Open weights on Hugging Face (HF Collection, Apache 2.0 licensed); can be served with vLLM and SGLang; GitHub repository available

ai_hyperparameter.value: max_new_tokens is set to 8192 in thinking mode (increase for complex reasoning) and 2048 in non-thinking mode

@graph.ai_informationAboutTraining:
Post-trained from Granite-4.1-8B-Base (pre-trained on a large-scale English and multilingual corpus) in stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on instruction-following, chain-of-thought and reasoning data, then multi-phase, multi-environment reinforcement learning using GRPO, followed by a preference-alignment (RLHF) phase.
training_hardware: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 cluster hosted in CoreWeave (72-GPU NVLink domain intra-rack; NDR 400 Gb/s InfiniBand Fat-Tree inter-rack); total GPU count not stated
@graph.comment:
access_conditions: false
additional_assets: A GitHub repository (ibm-granite/granite-4.2-language-models) lists the full training datasets; a technical blog, documentation, an HF collection of Granite 4.2 models, and an SGLang cookbook (deployment recipe) are also linked. The custom granite_thinking_parser is included in the model repository.
architecture_details: Decoder-only dense transformer (GraniteForCausalLM) with 8B parameters; Grouped Query Attention with 32 attention heads and 8 KV heads; RoPE (θ = 10,000,000); SwiGLU MLP (hidden size 12800); RMSNorm (ε = 1e-5); untied input/output embeddings; 40 layers; embedding size 4096. Dense model (no experts). No rationale for the design choices is stated.
design_rationale: The card gives some rationale for training choices: SFT uses instruction-following, chain-of-thought and reasoning data to cultivate reasoning and thinking abilities; hyperparameters were tuned before scaling to all three model sizes; for the 30B model a second SFT phase up-sampled agentic data while retaining a smaller share of general replay data. RL uses GRPO across multiple environments, with verifiable rewards where available and a generative reward model for open-ended prompts; an RLHF phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality, and safety.
integration_means: Can be served with vLLM (custom granite_thinking_parser reasoning parser, qwen3_coder tool-call parser) and SGLang (v0.5.18+), via OpenAI-compatible API; also usable with Hugging Face Transformers via tokenizer.apply_chat_template with enable_thinking, low_effort and tools options; ChatML-style prompt format with <think>...</think> reasoning.
eval_methodology: Evaluations are run with an evaluation framework based on NeMo Evaluator SDK. Generation settings recommended: temperature=1.0 and top_p=0.95 across all tasks (no shots/prompts stated for benchmarks).
base_model_relation: finetune
